title: एनपीएलकाे समूह चरणमा सर्वाधिक रन बनाउने शीर्ष १० ब्याटर- ५ जना नेपाली

No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेपाल प्रिमियर लिग (एनपीएल) को समूह चरणका म्याचहरू सकिएका छन् । समूह चरणका अधिकांश म्याचहरू लाे स्काेरिङ भए पनि पीचकाे अवस्था हेरेर ब्याटिङ गर्ने स्वदेशी र विदेशी ब्याटरहरू राम्राे छाप छोड्न सफल भए । समूह चरणमा नेपाली ब्याटरहरूकाे प्रदर्शन सुखद रहेको छ । महँगो मूल्यमा खरिद गरेर ल्याइएको विदेशी स्टारहरूको हाराहारीमै देखिए घरेलु खेलाडी । समूह चरण सकिँदासम्म सर्वाधिक रन बनाउने शीर्ष १० ब्याटरमा पाँच नेपाली र पाँच विदेशी खेलाडी परेका छन् । ४ म्याच मात्र खेलेका पोखरा एभेन्जर्सका युवराज सामरा २९४ रनसहित सर्वाधिक रन बनाउने ब्याटरको शीर्ष स्थानमा छन् । उनले चार खेलमा ७३.५० को औसत र १७९.२६ को स्ट्राइक रेटमा रन बनाएका छन् । कठिन कन्डिसनमा पनि विस्फोटक ब्याटिङ गर्दै उनले एक शतक र दुई अर्धशतक बनाए । पाेखरा एभेन्जर्स प्रतियोगिताबाट बाहिरिएकाले साम्राकाे यात्रा भने समाप्त भइसकेको छ । विराटनगर किंग्सका लोकेश बम २४२ रनसहित दोस्रो स्थानमा छन् । उनी अहिलेसम्म सर्वाधिक बनाउने घरेलु ब्याट्सम्यान हुन् । सात खेलमा ३४.५७ को औसत र १४२.३५ को स्ट्राइक रेटमा ब्याटिङ गरेका उनको उच्च स्कोर ८७ रन हो । उनले दुई अर्धशतक प्रहार गरे । सर्वाधिक छक्का भने लाेकेशकाे नाममा छ । उनले समूह चरणमा १८ छक्का हानेका छन् । विराटनगर पनि प्रतियोगिताबाट बाहिरिएको छ । पोखराकै कुशल भुर्तेल २३५ रनसहित तेस्रो स्थानमा छन् । सात खेलमा ३३.५७ को औसत र १४८.७३ को स्ट्राइक रेटमा खेलेका कुशलले दुई अर्धशतक प्रहार गरे । हिजो भएको खेलमा उनी कीर्तिमानी शतक बनाउन एक रनले चुके । भुर्तेलले समूह चरणमा १५ छक्का हानेका छन् । कर्णाली याक्सका राशिद खान १८६ रनसहित चौथो स्थानमा छन् । यसअघि बलिलङ अलराउण्डरकाे रूपमा चिनिँदै आएका रसिदले ब्याटबाट छाप छोड्न सफल भए । उनले सात खेलमा ३७.२० को औसत र १४१.९८ को स्ट्राइक रेटमा रन बनाएका छन् । उनले दुई अर्धशतक प्रहार गरे । यही प्रदर्शनका बलमा उनी एसीसी राइजिङ स्टार कपका लागि राष्ट्रिय टोलीमा पर्न सफल भएका छन् । चितवन राइनोजका रवि बोपारा १८४ रनसहित पाँचौँ स्थानमा छन् । चितवनको कप्तानी समेत गरेका उनले पाँच खेलमा ४६ को औसतमा रन बनाएका छन् । उनको उच्च स्कोर ५५ रन हो । बाेपाराले लगातार तेस्रो सिजन चितवनबाट खेलेका हुन् । कर्णाली याक्सका अरिफुल इस्लाम १८२ रनसहित छैटौँ स्थानमा छन् । उनले सात खेलमा १८२ को उच्च स्ट्राइक रेटमा ब्याटिङ गरेका छन् । उनले हरेक म्याचमा विस्फोटक सुरूवात गरे पनि ठूलाे स्काेर बनाउन भने असफल रहे । उनको उच्च स्कोर ४४ रन हो । स्ट्राइक रेटका हिसाबले उनी शीर्ष १० का ब्याटरमध्ये निकै आक्रामक देखिएका छन् । कर्णालीकै अलराउन्डर पवन सर्राफ १६७ रनसहित सातौँ स्थानमा छन् । पवनले पनि एनपीएलमा गरेको प्रदर्शनकै बलमा राष्ट्रिय टिमको ढोका ढक्ढकाए । राइजिङ कपमा स्थमन बनाउन सफल भए । पवनकाे स्ट्राइक रेट भने कमजोर रह्यो । सुदूरपश्चिम रोयल्सका कप्तान दीपेन्द्रसिंह ऐरी १५० रनसहित आठौँ स्थानमा छन् । उनले दुई अर्धशतक प्रहार गरेका छन् । प्लेअफमा अझै उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन गरेर आँकडा सुधार्ने अवसर उनीसित छ । चितवन राइनोजका इंग्लिस ब्याटर डाविड मलान १४९ रनसहित नवौँ स्थानमा छन् । उनले चार खेलमा ४९.६६ को औसतमा रन बनाएका छन् । उनको उच्च स्कोर ७० रन हो । लुम्बिनी लायन्सका अस्ट्रेलियन ब्याटर डार्सी सर्ट १४८ रनसहित दशौँ स्थानमा छन् । उनले ६ खेलमा २४.६६ को औसत र १४२.३० को स्ट्राइक रेटमा रन बनाएका छन् । समूह चरणमा सर्वाधिक रन बनाउने शीर्ष The group stage matches of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) have come to an end. Although most of the group stage matches were low scoring, the domestic and foreign batsmen, who batted according to the pitch conditions, managed to leave a good impression. The performance of Nepali batsmen in the group stage has been satisfactory. The domestic players have been on par with the expensively bought foreign stars. Five Nepalis and five foreign players are among the top 10 batsmen who have scored the most runs by the end of the group stage. Yuvraj Samara of Pokhara Avengers, who has played only 4 matches, is the top run-scoring batsman with 294 runs. He has scored runs at an average of 73.50 and a strike rate of 179.26 in four matches. He batted explosively even in difficult conditions, scoring a century and two half-centuries. Samra's journey is over as Pokhara Avengers are eliminated from the tournament. Lokesh Bam of Biratnagar Kings is in second place with 242 runs. He is the highest-scoring domestic batsman so far. He has batted in seven matches at an average of 34.57 and a strike rate of 142.35, with a highest score of 87 runs. He hit two half-centuries. Lokesh has the most sixes. He hit 18 sixes in the group stage. Biratnagar has also been eliminated from the tournament. Pokhara's Kushal Bhurtel is in third place with 235 runs. Kushal, who played seven matches at an average of 33.57 and a strike rate of 148.73, hit two half-centuries. He missed out on a record-breaking century by one run in yesterday's match. Bhurtel has hit 15 sixes in the group stage. Rashid Khan of Karnali Yaks is in fourth place with 186 runs. Rashid, who was previously known as a bowling all-rounder, has managed to make his mark with the bat. He has scored runs at an average of 37.20 and a strike rate of 141.98 in seven matches. He has hit two half-centuries. On the strength of this performance, he has been able to make it to the national team for the ACC Rising Star Cup. Chitwan Rhinos' Ravi Bopara is in fifth place with 184 runs. He has also captained Chitwan and has scored an average of 46 runs in five matches. His highest score is 55 runs. Bopara is playing for Chitwan for the third consecutive season. Ariful Islam of Karnali Yaks is in sixth place with 182 runs. He has batted at a high strike rate of 182 in seven matches. Despite making explosive starts in every match, he has failed to score big scores. His highest score is 44 runs. He has been seen as one of the most aggressive batsmen in the top 10 in terms of strike rate. Karnali's all-rounder Pawan Saraf is in seventh place with 167 runs. Pawan also knocked on the door of the national team on the strength of his performance in the NPL. He managed to make a place in the Rising Cup. Pawan's strike rate remained weak. Sudurpaschim Royals captain Deependra Singh Airi is in eighth place with 150 runs. He has hit two half-centuries. He has the opportunity to improve his figures by performing even better in the playoffs. Chitwan Rhinos' English batsman Dawid Malan is in ninth place with 149 runs. He has scored runs at an average of 49.66 in four matches. His highest score is 70 runs. Lumbini Lions' Australian batsman DRC Short is in tenth place with 148 runs. He has scored runs in 6 matches at an average of 24.66 and a strike rate of 142.30. Top 10 batsmen with the most runs in the group stage 1. Yuvraj Samara (Pokhara) – 294 runs 2.
